roles.title: Product Marketing Intern - Tetriz
roles.desc:
About Tetriz 
 Tetriz helps engineering orgs become AI-native, faster.
Observability that turns AI blind spots into measured signals, coaching that improves how engineers direct AI, and governance that catches risk without surveillance.

 The role 
 This is a six-month, full-time product marketing internship, based in our Bengaluru office.

 Most of our marketing already runs on AI agents. We have a content engine built on Claude (for SEO blogs, founder LinkedIn content, Reddit programs, YouTube scripts), outbound infrastructure on Apollo/HubSpot, and competitive intelligence workflows.

 You will not be shadowing this machine — you will be running parts of it. You own the content engine, and you support the rest of the marketing function alongside the team.

 If your instinct when given a repetitive task is "I should build a skill/workflow for this," you'll fit. If your instinct is to open a blank doc, this will frustrate you. 

 What you'll own 
 1. Content engine 
 
 
 Run the SEO blog pipeline: briefs, drafts, editorial QA against our standards, publishing, and refresh cycles

 
 Ship LinkedIn posts and company page content on a weekly calendar

 
 Draft and iterate YouTube scripts, titles, descriptions, and thumbnail concepts; track what actually earns clicks

 
 Keep website and landing page copy current, and flag what has gone stale

 
 2. Outbound and growth ops 
 
 
 Help run the email and social outbound machine: list building, enrichment, sequence setup, deliverability hygiene

 
 Pull weekly campaign performance into a simple report and call out what isn't working

 
 3. Launch and channel presence 
 
 
 Support launch-week execution across relevant platforms

 
 Help build our G2 and Capterra presence: profile setup, review-generation outreach, drafting responses

 
 Monitor the communities where our buyers actually are, and surface what's worth engaging with

 
 4. Lifecycle and customer marketing 
 
 
 Help draft the PLG email lifecycle: onboarding nurture for new signups and activation prompts

 
 Assist on case studies — interview notes, first drafts, and capturing named customer quotes

 
 Keep sales assets tidy and current: one-pagers, pitch deck updates, battlecards

 
 What we need 
 
 
 Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree, with 0–1 years of experience. A prior marketing internship, a blog or newsletter you run, or a side project you actually shipped all count.

 
 AI-native. You use Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor daily as a working tool, not a novelty. You can show us prompts, workflows, or agents you've built to do your own work faster. This is the single biggest filter — it matters more to us than your CV.

 
 Strong writing skills. You'll be editing AI output for a technical US audience, so you need the judgment to catch what's generic, wrong, or off-brand.

 
 Reliability. Outbound infrastructure fails quietly. We need someone who checks the dashboard before anyone asks.

 
 Available full-time, in office in Bengaluru, for the full six months.

 
 Nice to have: exposure to Apollo.io, HubSpot or similar tools, basic SEO fundamentals, curiosity about the developer tools ecosystem, basic video or design editing (Canva, CapCut, Figma).

 What you'll get 
 
 
 A front-row seat to a US GTM launch, working directly with the founders

 
 The most AI-leveraged marketing stack you'll find at any company this size — you'll build skills most marketers won't have for years

 
 Real ownership from week one. No approval chains, no busywork

 
 A monthly stipend, and a full-time offer on the table for interns who perform

roles.title: Ai Engg Intern
roles.desc:
Tetriz is an AI Engineering Intelligence platform that helps engineering organizations become AI-native, faster. We measure how AI coding tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot are actually used, improve engineer effectiveness through prompt and workflow coaching, and help engineering leaders demonstrate AI ROI with board-ready, defensible insights.
 You'll be joining at an exciting stage of our journey, working alongside experienced engineers to build AI-native products used by engineering teams. From day one, you'll contribute to real product development, ship production code, and build with the latest AI technologies.
 What you'll work on 

 
 Build and ship real product features.

 Work with LLMs, APIs, and backend systems.

 Contribute to developer tooling and AI-powered workflows.

 Use AI tools to accelerate development, debugging, and problem-solving.

 Ship fast, iterate quickly, and continuously improve what you build.

 
 What we're looking for 

 
 Actively uses AI tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar in personal or academic projects.

 A GitHub profile that reflects genuine curiosity, initiative, and a habit of building.

 At least one meaningful project outside of coursework.

 Strong programming fundamentals in a backend or full-stack language (Python, Go, Node.js, etc.).

 The ability to learn independently, solve unfamiliar problems, and figure things out.

 A self-directed builder who doesn't wait to be told what to do next.

 
 Strong signals 

 
 AI-powered projects or developer tools.

 Experience building APIs, backend systems, or SaaS products.

 Open-source contributions or hackathons.

 Startup internships or side projects.

 A public GitHub with meaningful commits.

 
 We aspire to build an inclusive team because diverse perspectives lead to better products and better decisions. We hire based on merit and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

roles.title: DS/ML Intern
roles.desc:
A builder mindset is the core of this role and where you'll spend most of your time. But we're a small team building a whole product, not a research lab. The best person here treats ML systems as their primary craft while staying willing to do whatever the product needs — thinking through the product itself, shipping backend or frontend code, untangling data pipelines. We're looking for someone energized by the breadth, not someone who wants to stay in their lane.

What you'll work on

Evaluation systems for AI features
Help build the eval backbone our AI features ship against — failure taxonomies, LLM-as-judge rubrics, golden datasets, calibration against human judgment.
Learn what it takes to keep automated scores honest as models and prompts change. A feature with no eval has no quality floor.
Model routing & inference economics
Get hands-on with how we route work across models — balancing cost, quality, and latency per task.
Help run the experiments that justify those choices and catch regressions.
Scoring, measurement & signal quality
Work on turning noisy, real-world signals into scores you can actually trust — grounded in real statistical rigor, not vibes.
Help move heuristic-driven approaches toward calibrated, monitored systems.
MLOps & production
Get exposure to the full lifecycle — feature pipelines, model versioning, rollout, monitoring for drift and silent quality decay.
Work alongside engineering to see how models get served reliably at low latency.
What we're looking for

Must have
Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in CS, DS, ML, or a related field.
Some hands-on DS/ML experience — coursework, personal projects, research, or a prior internship — where you've built and run something end to end, not just notebooks.
Comfort with Python and working SQL knowledge.
Basic grounding in applied statistics — you can explain what a metric means and when it might be misleading.
A builder's instinct — genuinely curious about product decisions, backend, or frontend, not just the modeling layer.
Some exposure to LLMs — prompting, using APIs, or experimenting with model behavior.
Nice to have
Any exposure to evaluation or observability tooling for LLM features.
Coursework or projects in information retrieval, entity-matching, or record-linkage.
Interest in developer-productivity, code analytics, or DevEx data.

roles.title: GenAI Product Builder Intern
roles.desc:
GenAI Product Builder Intern

About us
Tetriz is an AI Engineering Intelligence platform that helps engineering organizations become AI-native, faster. We measure how AI coding tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot are actually used, improve engineer effectiveness through prompt and workflow coaching, and help engineering leaders demonstrate AI ROI with board-ready, defensible insights.

Who should apply
This is not a general internship, you should apply only if:
- You’ve built or designed things outside of college
- You have a portfolio / GitHub of real work
- Your work shows initiative, not just completion
- You care about problems, not just tools
If your experience is mostly coursework, this won’t be a fit.
 What you’ll get - Work on a real AI product used by engineering teams
- Own problems end-to-end, not assist someone else
- Exposure to cutting-edge GenAI workflows - A steep learning curve — we’ll push you hard and help you grow fast
If you’re hungry and serious, you’ll leave this internship 10x better and ready for the AI-first world.

What you’ll do
- Build features end-to-end — from idea to production - Work with LLMs, APIs, and internal systems - Create tools that improve developer workflows - Ship fast, iterate, and improve based on usage
What we’re looking for
GitHub that feels like a product portfolio
- Projects with real users / real utility - Ability to explain why something should exist - Comfort getting your hands dirty and figuring things out
Strong signals - Tools, extensions, SaaS projects, or AI apps - Product launches (even small ones) - Writing about what you build (optional but great)
